title: When attachment keeps tightening the grip after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: The mind keeps clinging to what it cannot finally keep. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru teaches love without possession and steadiness without denial. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: Freedom is not numbness. It is steadiness before what usually hooks the mind. Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it.
actionPrompt: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
